ops.prevDaySetup: Usage time includes setup and cleanup time. The hall has 8-hour, 12-hour and 24-hour rates; night-time or 24-hour use may not be available depending on the bookings before and after, so consult in advance. Except for some venues, the venue can be used 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Advance load-in of packages is in principle arranged for arrival on the day before the event, and the number of items and the item names are written on the advance load-in notice and submitted (valuables are not accepted). Packages received in advance are limited to 5 boxes per hall. (Source: Hall price list, updated July 3, 2026; FAQ; Advance Load-in Notice)
ops.loadingHours: Delivery vehicles for load-in and load-out must enter and leave within the usage time. An advance load-in notice must be submitted at least 1 week before the work date (the loading area cannot be used if it is not submitted). Loading and unloading is in principle limited to 20 minutes. The on-site manager completes entry procedures at the 1F Service Center before starting work. The loading areas are on B1F: Loading Area 1 has an entrance door of W3,000 x H3,300 mm, and Loading Area 3 is W2,800 x H2,375 mm. For the 2F hall, the load-in elevator is reached from Loading Area 2 (car interior W2,550 x H2,500 x D1,800 mm, entrance door W1,600 x H2,500 mm). 4-ton trucks can load in directly. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice, Equipment List updated October 30, 2026, official facility page)
ops.vehicleRules: The loading area is used only for loading and unloading; if parking is needed, use an outside parking lot. When multiple vehicles are used, they share one vehicle's loading space in staggered turns. Illegal parking and roadside parking around the building outside the designated parking lot are strictly prohibited. Vehicle limits are: Loading Area 1, height 3,200 x length 7,000 x width 6,000 mm, weight 2.0 t; Loading Area 2, height 3,300 x length 9,000 x width 2,600 mm, 2.0 t; Loading Area 3, height 3,300 x length 9,000 x width 6,100 mm, 4.0 t. Loading Areas 1 and 3 can hold about 2 passenger cars left standing, and Loading Area 2 about 1 passenger car. Products, packing materials, trash and the like may not be left in the loading area during the usage period. (Source: Advance Load-in Notice, Equipment List updated October 30, 2026, Terms of Use 2026ver2 Article 15)
ops.parking: There is no dedicated Bellesalle parking lot and no hourly parking lot. To find nearby parking lots, search for "Bellesalle Shibuya First" on "s-park" (Tokyo Metropolitan Road Improvement and Conservation Corporation), which is linked from the official facility page. (Source: Equipment List updated October 30, 2026, official facility page)
ops.waitingRooms: There are 4 waiting rooms, 120㎡ in total, free of charge. On B1F: Waiting Room 1 (39㎡) and Waiting Room 2 (40㎡); on 2F: Waiting Room A (26㎡) and Waiting Room B (15㎡). (Source: Official facility page, Equipment List updated October 30, 2026)
ops.catering: An "outside food/drink fee" applies if a caterer other than the operator's designated vendors is used (party use only; bringing in drinks only or boxed meals is not covered). The amount depends on venue area: up to 300㎡ 100,000 yen, up to 600㎡ 200,000 yen, up to 900㎡ 300,000 yen, up to 1,200㎡ 400,000 yen, 1,201㎡ and above 500,000 yen (110,000 to 550,000 yen each, tax included). Party menus for receptions are introduced on the website of Izumi Restaurant, a Sumitomo Fudosan Group company. (Source: Outside Food/Drink Fee Guide, FAQ)
